column1: # english<TAB>telugu-script pronunciation. Longest match wins. Case-insensitive, except
# all-caps entries of 4 letters or fewer, which match only in capitals (IT is not "it").
# Plurals of an entry are handled automatically (Assessees -> అసెస్సీలు).
# Added 2026-11-07 for the YouTube video pipeline (Claude, Python, FFmpeg were mispronounced)
